The Honda NSX is back! That’s right, the 1990s supercar icon that pushed Ferrari to make its cars more usable and reliable has been given the restomod treatment. It’s the work of JAS – a long-time motorsport partner of Honda (and yes, Honda has given its blessing to this project) – together with Italian design house Pininfarina, which designed the original HP-X concept that inspired the Mk1 NSX. Is it sacrilege, or superb?
JAS Tensei (Honda NSX Mk1)
Tom Ford
This is a commercial channel from BBC Studios.
